name: Lady of Ariandel
description: (Tag:character)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:non-combatant)(Character)A draconic child of the painted world of Ariandel trained in creating "Painted Worlds". Given sufficiently powerful catalysts made into paint, she can create self-contained pocket worlds entered only through their paintings, with size and quality depending on paint potency, but she has little to no combat ability. (Note: She is not immortal)
